title: White Illagers
description: White illagers are now in Minecraft!
body:
**Ever wanted to have white illagers in Minecraft? Then this resource pack is for you! This resource pack changes the texture of illagers — every illager will look like this.**

![Illagers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e561a443e2af516680fb9eb66b78ba458a40433a.png)

_Supports Fresh Animations_
